description: Decode the vocabulary the other faa_delays tools return: event types and their fields, traffic-management terms (AAR, EDCT, FCA, GDP, SWAP), ARTCC center codes, the FAA pacing airports with time zones, and accepted identifier formats.

topic.description: What to decode: event_types (event types and their key fields), terms (traffic-management abbreviations), artccs (ARTCC center codes and names), pacing_airports (the FAA pacing airports with time zones, read live), or identifiers (accepted airport-code, advisory, and time formats). Case-insensitive; spaces and hyphens read as underscores.

name: faa_delays_list_reference

artccs.description: Present for topic artccs, by code: the 25 US ARTCCs, including the New York and Oakland oceanic centers, plus Anchorage Oceanic, Guam, Auckland Oceanic, Toronto, and Vancouver, the other facilities NASR names as an airport's ARTCC. Every artcc faa_delays_get_airport_status returns is listed.

code.description: Facility code: three letters starting with Z (ZSE), or a 4-letter ICAO FIR code (NZZO).

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `feed_unavailable`: NAS Status unreachable, 5xx, an attempt timeout, or an HTML maintenance page, after retries (topic pacing_airports only). `upstream_rate_limited`: The FAA returned 429 after retries, or this server's queue to the FAA would wait past 10 s while backing off from an FAA 429 (topic pacing_airports only). `retry_deadline_exceeded`: The 20 s retry budget ran out (topic pacing_airports only). `pacer_shed`: This server's own queue to the FAA would wait past 10 s with no FAA 429 backoff in effect (topic pacing_airports only). `feed_contract_changed`: The pacing-airports path returned 404/410, or a body whose shape this server no longer recognizes. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

eventTypes.description: Present for topic event_types, in severity order.

keyFields.description: Output fields that carry the detail of this event type.

items.description: Output field name, with a note where useful.

meaning.description: What the event means, per the FAA NAS Status user guide.

fetchedAt.description: Present for topic pacing_airports: when this server fetched the list from the FAA (UTC ISO).

airportDirectory.description: The bundled FAA NASR airport directory that validates airport codes. An identifier assigned after this cycle is rejected until the next refresh.

source.description: FAA dataset the directory is built from.

formats.description: Identifier and time formats the faa_delays tools accept and return.

pacingAirports.description: Present for topic pacing_airports: the FAA pacing airports, read live and cached 6 h.

timezone.description: IANA-style time zone the FAA assigns (US/Pacific); FAA-supplied text.

meaning.description: What it means in FAA traffic management.

title: List FAA Delay Reference Data
